newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev ends firm on rise of dollar supply.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev ends firm on rise of dollar supply.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed at 231.00/80, up from 231.80/232 in the morning on the interbank market due to a rise of foreign currency supply from the central bank and commercial banks, traders said.
"The BNB sold dollars throughout the day, beginning at 232 levs in the morning and lowering its asks to 231.00/30 amid moderate foreign currency demand, which supported the lev," a bank dealer said.

Some traders said sales by the BNB stimulated commercial banks and final clients to shorten forex positions ahead of a possible further lev's rise to profit on record high yield on lev-denominated investments.
The BNB this week raised its central interest rate to 25 percent monthly or 300 percent annually from 108 percent to support the declining lev.
The lev traded near 237 on Monday before the rate rise was announced.
Dealers said they expected trade to be calm and in small volumes next week without any sharp movements in the lev/dollar exchange rate. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-84561
